newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two Japan paperboard makers to merge - Nikkei.
newsitem.headline: Two Japan paperboard makers to merge - Nikkei.

text.p: Leading paperboard maker Japan Paper Industry Co Ltd and Jujo Paper Board Co Ltd, both in the Nippon Paper Industries Co Ltd group, have agreed to merge in October, a financial daily said on Friday.
The merged firm will be the country's second-largest paperboard producer after Oji Paper Co Ltd, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Nippon Paper and Oji Paper are Japan's top paper companies which produce various types of paper and paper-related products. Jujo is unlisted.
The Tokyo Stock Exchange said on Friday it had suspended trade in Japan Paper Industries Co Ltd shares due to a lack of clarity stemming from the media reports.
Total annual sales of the merged firm are expected to top 100 billion yen and paperboard output is seen at around 1.5 million tonnes per year, the paper said.
The new company will also take over the paperboard marketing operations of Nippon Paper subsidiary Tohoku Paper Industries Co Ltd, a paperboard company in northen Japan, the paper said.
The move is part of Nippon Paper's efforts to streamline paperboard business in its group, the newspaper said, adding that it might lead to an overall restructuring of the paperboard industry.
Officials of the companies were not immediately available for comment.
